### How Respondent Works for Participants

* **Signing Up:** You can create an account in about 90 seconds. Sign-up is free (no credit card required) using an email address, Google, or LinkedIn. Phone and email verification are required, alongside a one-time identity check that is reused across all future studies.
* **Building a Profile:** You provide demographic details, employment information (industry, job title, seniority, company size), and the software tools/products you use daily. Connecting your LinkedIn profile or verifying a work email is recommended, as it validates professional credentials for premium B2B studies.
* **Finding & Qualifying for Studies:** 
  * You can browse active studies directly on your dashboard or receive automated invitations (typically 1–3 targeted invitations per month).
  * To qualify, you complete an unpaid screener questionnaire (usually 2–20 questions). Some partner studies may ask for a secondary screener off-site.
  * If the researcher selects your responses, you receive an invitation with a calendar link to pick a session time (for moderated video/in-person interviews) or instructions to begin async tasks/surveys.
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Tremendous**.
  * Average compensation is ~$75 for a 45-minute consumer session, ranging from $50–$250 for general studies and $200–$500+ for senior professional/B2B interviews.
  * After the researcher verifies attendance/completion (typically within 48 hours to a few days), payment is released to Tremendous (usually arriving within 7–10 business days).
  * You redeem your Tremendous link for PayPal, direct deposit, Visa virtual debit cards, or major retail gift cards (Amazon, etc.). Respondent deducts a **5% fulfillment fee** (minimum $1.00) from participant earnings.

---

### How Terac Works for Participants

* **Platform Overview:** Terac operates as an AI-native expert network and research panel recruiting professionals, domain specialists, and everyday consumers for AI evaluations, surveys, data annotation, and voice/video interviews.
* **Onboarding & Setup:**
  * **Account Creation:** Sign up via OAuth (LinkedIn is the primary recommended option to pre-fill work history; Google, Microsoft, and Facebook are also supported).
  * **Profile Setup:** You can upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) which Terac automatically parses to populate your work history, education, and credentials alongside LinkedIn data. You must also verify your phone via SMS code.
  * **Earning "Attestations":** Terac uses a structured credentialing system called **Attestations** (verified badges). Specific studies require particular attestations before you are allowed to apply. Common attestations include Government ID verification (via Stripe Identity / Persona), LinkedIn profile verification, work email domain verification, and geolocation/IP verification.
  * **Study Tools:** Beyond web surveys and AI-moderated voice interviews, certain specialized tasks on Terac require installing third-party time-tracking software (**Insightful** desktop app).
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Virtual Incentives**.
  * Earnings accumulate in your Terac balance (`terac.com/me/earnings`) as tasks/submissions are approved.
  * To cash out, you **must** have completed a verified Government ID attestation. Once initiated, you receive a Virtual Incentives redemption email for digital cards, bank transfers, or gift cards.

---

### Respondent vs. Terac: Comparison & Onboarding Assessment

* **Is Terac easier or more involved to get started with?**  
  **Terac is noticeably more involved to get started with than Respondent.**
  * **Why Terac is more involved:** While both platforms support fast initial OAuth sign-ins, Terac requires a much deeper onboarding process centered on credential verification. Getting full access requires parsing a resume, clearing multiple formal **Attestations** (government ID scans, work domain verification, LinkedIn syncing), and for certain studies, running desktop monitoring/time-tracking software. Furthermore, cashouts cannot be released without an approved government ID on file.
  * **Why Respondent is simpler:** Respondent relies on a lightweight, standard intake form (~90 seconds) where you immediately gain access to the marketplace and can start answering screener questionnaires without mandatory resume parsing or multi-tiered attestation gates.

---

### SurveyMonkey Screener Verification

* The SurveyMonkey screener page was opened and **successfully verified to load with visible survey questions**.
* **Page Title:** *ATCKs and Romantic Relationships Screener Survey*
* **Visible Questions Loaded:** The page displays interactive intake and screener questions, including Question 1 (Full name), Question 2 (Age), Question 3 (Sex: Female / Male / Other), Question 4 (Gender/Pronouns), Question 5 (Relationship status), Question 6 (Adult Third Culture Kid status), Question 7 (Locations lived before 18), through Question 13, complete with response fields and an active progress indicator.

TASK_COMPLETE -> ANSWER: ### How Respondent Works for Participants

* **Signing Up:** You can create an account in about 90 seconds. Sign-up is free (no credit card required) using an email address, Google, or LinkedIn. Phone and email verification are required, alongside a one-time identity check that is reused across all future studies.
* **Building a Profile:** You provide demographic details, employment information (industry, job title, seniority, company size), and the software tools/products you use daily. Connecting your LinkedIn profile or verifying a work email is recommended, as it validates professional credentials for premium B2B studies.
* **Finding & Qualifying for Studies:** 
  * You can browse active studies directly on your dashboard or receive automated invitations (typically 1–3 targeted invitations per month).
  * To qualify, you complete an unpaid screener questionnaire (usually 2–20 questions). Some partner studies may ask for a secondary screener off-site.
  * If the researcher selects your responses, you receive an invitation with a calendar link to pick a session time (for moderated video/in-person interviews) or instructions to begin async tasks/surveys.
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Tremendous**.
  * Average compensation is ~$75 for a 45-minute consumer session, ranging from $50–$250 for general studies and $200–$500+ for senior professional/B2B interviews.
  * After the researcher verifies attendance/completion (typically within 48 hours to a few days), payment is released to Tremendous (usually arriving within 7–10 business days).
  * You redeem your Tremendous link for PayPal, direct deposit, Visa virtual debit cards, or major retail gift cards (Amazon, etc.). Respondent deducts a **5% fulfillment fee** (minimum $1.00) from participant earnings.

### How Terac Works for Participants

* **Platform Overview:** Terac operates as an AI-native expert network and research panel recruiting professionals, domain specialists, and everyday consumers for AI evaluations, surveys, data annotation, and voice/video interviews.
* **Onboarding & Setup:**
  * **Account Creation:** Sign up via OAuth (LinkedIn is the primary recommended option to pre-fill work history; Google, Microsoft, and Facebook are also supported).
  * **Profile Setup:** You can upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) which Terac automatically parses to populate your work history, education, and credentials alongside LinkedIn data. You must also verify your phone via SMS code.
  * **Earning "Attestations":** Terac uses a structured credentialing system called **Attestations** (verified badges). Specific studies require particular attestations before you are allowed to apply. Common attestations include Government ID verification (via Stripe Identity / Persona), LinkedIn profile verification, work email domain verification, and geolocation/IP verification.
  * **Study Tools:** Beyond web surveys and AI-moderated voice interviews, certain specialized tasks on Terac require installing third-party time-tracking software (**Insightful** desktop app).
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Virtual Incentives**.
  * Earnings accumulate in your Terac balance (`terac.com/me/earnings`) as tasks/submissions are approved.
  * To cash out, you **must** have completed a verified Government ID attestation. Once initiated, you receive a Virtual Incentives redemption email for digital cards, bank transfers, or gift cards.

* **Is Terac easier or more involved to get started with?**  
  **Terac is noticeably more involved to get started with than Respondent.**
  * **Why Terac is more involved:** While both platforms support fast initial OAuth sign-ins, Terac requires a much deeper onboarding process centered on credential verification. Getting full access requires parsing a resume, clearing multiple formal **Attestations** (government ID scans, work domain verification, LinkedIn syncing), and for certain studies, running desktop monitoring/time-tracking software. Furthermore, cashouts cannot be released without an approved government ID on file.
